transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. __. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Um, I guess what brings me in is that... I just feel like I can’t settle in my own body anymore. It's really been bothering me, especially when I’m supposed to sit quietly and handle things like paperwork, or when I need to sit down and go over shared household plans. I just can't seem to stay settled.
Do you also feel worried or nervous most days?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel worried or nervous most days. I mean, I have normal everyday stress, but... it's not an anxious feeling. It's really just that physical feeling of not being able to sit still, rather than feeling worried in my head.
Have you always had this kind of restlessness, even since childhood?

Yeah, I have. Looking back... I think this was already part of me way back in elementary school. I was always the girl with a completely messy desk, and I was constantly forgetting my permission slips. My parents used to get notes from my teachers saying that I talked out of turn a lot, or that I just seemed unable to stay seated during class. So, yeah, it's been there for a long time.
